name: Fire Bolt
description: Hurl a small bolt of flame at a target.

name: Light
description: Make an object shine with steady magical light.

name: Mage Hand
description: Create a small spectral hand for simple manipulation.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create a small sound or image illusion.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Create small sensory, cleaning, warming, cooling, or harmless magical effects.

name: Dancing Lights
description: Create hovering lights that illuminate an area.

name: Mending
description: Repair a small break or tear in an object.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Create a minor supernatural sign such as booming voice, tremors, or altered flames.

name: Poison Spray
description: Project noxious magic that forces a Constitution save.

name: Chill Touch
description: Channel necrotic chill through a spell attack.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Call radiant power onto a creature that must resist it.

name: Guidance
description: Bolster a creature for an upcoming ability check.

name: Druidcraft
description: Create a small natural omen, sensory effect, or plant flourish.

name: Produce Flame
description: Conjure flame for light and hurl it when needed.

name: Cure Wounds
description: Restore hit points to a creature you touch.

name: Speak with Animals
description: Understand and verbally communicate with Beasts.

name: Magic Missile
description: Create darts of force that strike unerringly.

name: Shield
description: Raise a brief magical defense against danger.

name: Bless
description: Bolster allies' attacks and saves.

name: Command
description: Speak a one-word command that a creature must resist.

name: Shield of Faith
description: Protect a creature with shimmering faith for a brief defensive boost.

name: Divine Favor
description: Charge your weapon strikes with radiant conviction.

name: Healing Word
description: Restore a small burst of hit points with a quick word.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Outline creatures with light, making them easier to hit.

name: Hex
description: Curse a target to suffer extra harm from you.

name: Armor of Agathys
description: Wrap yourself in protective frost that punishes nearby attackers.

name: Charm Person
description: Magically influence a humanoid that fails to resist your charm.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a quarry so your weapon hits bite harder.

name: Sleep
description: Send weak or worn-down creatures into magical sleep.

name: Thunderwave
description: Release a wave of thunderous force around you.
